name: AeroGuard.tech
tagline: A real-time operations centre for cyber incidents and disasters: detect, triage, coordinate and audit.

awards: [MLH] Best Use of Snowflake API // [MLH] Meilleure utilisation de Snowflake API

problem: Response teams face too many alerts, unexplained urgency, slow coordination and low trust.
solution: A FastAPI and React platform with WebSocket updates, schema-checked services and audit records for prioritising incidents.
demo_moment: Team-described: incidents stream in and get triaged on the dashboard.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of Snowflake API // [MLH] Meilleure utilisation de Snowflake API” among 260 submissions.
Treats auditability as a core feature.

lessons: Audit trails make a dashboard feel operational rather than decorative.
